name: Gáilióin

attributes.attribute: Another name for the Fir Bolg.
One of the ancient mythic races of Ireland.
They ruled Ireland until the Tuatha Dé Danann defeated them at Mag Tuired.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gáilióin is another name for the Fir Bolg, an early mythic people of Ireland. See the entry for Fir Bolg. The Fir Bolg ruled Ireland until the Tuatha Dé Danann defeated them at Mag Tuired.

okr.objective: Clarify Gáilióin as an alternate name of the Fir Bolg, an ancient mythic race of Ireland.
